identification: Mixed paper and ephemera box. Best items: Christmas Number of The Bulletin, 9 Dec 1899 (Fry's Malted Cocoa cover, issue number faint); Axemen's Grand Carnival official programme (early 1900s, venue unread); Royal Military Tournament programme; The Bookman Portfolio. Rest is ordinary booklets, maps, TV Week, press photos, one faded albumen photo of draught horses.
